sentences.text:
KANAV GOYAL AND ANOTHER  PETITIONERS  VS.
UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS  RESPONDENTS CORAM:- HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SHEEL NAGU, CHIEF JUSTICE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJIV BERRY Present:- Mr. Kanav Goyal, (petitioner in person) and  Advocate for the petitioners.

Mr. Dheeraj Jain, Senior Advocate, with  Ms. Gurneet Sagoo, Advocate  for respondents No.1 to 3- UOI.
 Mr. Neeraj Gupta, Addl.

Mr. Salil Sabhlok, Sr. DAG, Punjab.
 *****
SANJIV BERRY, J.
1.

The instant writ petition has been preferred by the petitioners seeking issuance of a writ directing respondent No.1 to 9 to form Standing Operating Procedure for strict compliance of FSSAI Act,
2006, and Regulations of FSSAI Rules, 2011 besides other reliefs.

2. The grievance of the petitioners is that Food Safety Officers are not discharging their duties effectively as provided under the guidelines /rules of the FSSAI Act and there is no set standard procedure for the compliance of norms provided under Food Safety Act for compulsory registration of manufacturers, hawkers, mobile vendors etc.
nor there are any coercive steps being taken against the wrong doers as per law.

sentences.text: Raising the aforesaid grievance, petitioners have preferred a legal notice dated 03.10.2025 (Annexure P-7) to respondents, however no action has been taken upon the same till date.

4. At the very outset, the learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that at this stage, for the purpose of the instant petition, the petitioners will be satisfied if appropriate directions are given to respondents to consider and dispose of legal notice dated 03.10.2025 (Annexure P-7) in accordance with law and thereafter, if need be, to revisit the Court for redressal of his grievance.

5. Learned counsel representing the contesting respondents submit that the representation/legal notice dated 03.10.2025 (Annexure P-7) will be considered in accordance with law by the competent authority.

6. In view of the aforesaid submissions, without commenting on the merits of the instant writ petition and considering the limited request made by learned counsel for the petitioners, the petition is hereby disposed of with a direction to respondent No. 4 and 7 to decide the representation/legal notice dated 03.10.2025 (Annexure P-7) moved by the petitioners, in accordance with law by passing a speaking order, within a period of 2 months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.
7.
Copy of the order so passed by respondents be also communicated to the petitioners as well.

(SANJIV BERRY) (SHEEL NAGU)
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE Dated: 17.11.2025 Gyan i) Whether speaking/reasoned? Yes/No  ii) Whether reportable? Yes/No  2 of 2 Kanav Goyal And Another vs Union Of India And Others on 17 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144886029/
